name: The Last Ninjas
summary: These are glowing ninjas. It seems like there is more than just shadow behind those burning eyes ...
legend: When the last dojo burned, its students did not die. They faded into the dark, and only their light remained. Villagers whisper of the Shadow Ninja, a black silhouette traced in thin teal lines that vanishes before a torch can find it. They speak of the Oni Ninja, whose two blood-red eyes are the last thing a bandit ever sees. Lately the tales have grown stranger: a Neon Shogun in gold-trimmed armour, a crimson seal burning on his chest, gathering the lost under one banner. And beside him walks a pale Marionette with mismatched white eyes, moving without anyone pulling its strings. Every night another glow appears on the horizon. Count the lights carefully. One of them is already watching you...
altNames: The Last Ninjas: Glow of the Fallen Dojo
Neon Shinobi: Eyes in the Dark

versions.note: The first three rise from the ashes of the dojo: the teal-lined Shadow Ninja, the red-eyed Oni Ninja and the violet-glowing Phantom Ninja.
New lights flicker in the dark: the ember-orange Kitsune Ninja, the Storm Ronin crackling with ice-blue sparks, and the Void Wraith scattered with toxic green glow.
A Neon Shogun in gold armour with a crimson seal on his chest has come to claim the fallen. A pale Cursed Marionette with white doll eyes follows close behind.

logoPrompt: Square logo, a single blocky Minecraft-style ninja figure (Shadow Ninja) in an all-black pixelated suit, a glowing teal-cyan visor slit across the eyes, thin teal neon lines on the chest, shoulders and belt, and a teal glowing stripe along the bottom of the feet, dramatic teal rim light and soft bloom, deep dark navy-black background with faint mist, low-angle heroic pose, high contrast, no text
coverPrompt: Wide cinematic cover, three blocky Minecraft-style ninja figures standing side by side in all-black pixelated armour: on the left the Shadow Ninja with a teal-cyan visor slit and thin teal glowing lines on chest and feet; in the centre the Neon Shogun with gold-amber glowing helmet crest, gold eye slit, gold stripes on arms and legs and a glowing crimson-red emblem on the chest; on the right the Oni Ninja with two blood-red glowing eyes and red glowing marks on the chest and a red stripe at the feet. Background: a burned Japanese dojo at night under a dark moonlit sky, drifting embers and fog, neon glow reflecting on wet stone. Big stylised glowing title text "THE LAST NINJAS" across the top in Japanese-brush-inspired neon letters.
